result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # separator row is the all-4 row; compare the 4-row blocks above and below
    sep = next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 4 for x in r))
    a = grid[:sep]
    b = grid[sep+1:]
    return [[3 if a[i][j] == 0 and b[i][j] == 0 else 0 for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(len(a))]"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    # Locate the solid separator row; the binary patterns immediately above
    # and below it are compared cell by cell.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 4)
    a = grid[sep-4:sep]
    b = grid[sep+1:sep+5]
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == 0 and b[r][c] == 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(4)]"}
